relations: Cloud masses morph and drift slowly, while luminous gaps and crepuscular rays hold roughly stable positions.
Darker cloud bodies on the left lighten and soften as the overall scene hazes toward a brighter tone.
The view tilts gradually downward, causing a dark hill silhouette to emerge and grow along the bottom-right edge.
A small dark speck drifts faintly across the right side in the later portion of the view.
caption: The video captures an overcast sky filled with textured gray stratocumulus clouds, the sun concealed behind clouds, with a bright opening near the upper center and a smaller gap below, from which soft crepuscular rays fan diagonally toward the lower left. Throughout the view the cloud masses morph and drift only very slowly, while the luminous gaps and the fan of rays hold roughly the same positions. The darker cloud bodies on the left lighten and soften a touch as the overall scene hazes toward a brighter tone. The view also tilts gradually downward, so a dark hill silhouette absent at the start emerges and grows along the bottom-right edge. A small dark speck drifts faintly across the right side in the later portion. The slow drift and brightening persist without any event reaching a conclusion.
